title: Remove Launch preflight flat aliases
summary: Removed eight Launch backend-preflight compatibility aliases from the flat window surface while preserving the mediaPipelineLaunchView namespace contract.
reason: Continue opportunistic WebView flat-export cleanup in a touched Launch/Queue evidence domain without changing backend mutation, media policy, command routing, source media handling, or pending-publish behavior.
behavior_before: Launch backend-preflight helpers were available both through window.mediaPipelineLaunchView and direct flat window.* aliases; Queue launch handoff, Launch command history, and shared command-history evidence could read the flat aliases.
behavior_after: Launch backend-preflight helpers remain available through window.mediaPipelineLaunchView only; Queue launch handoff, Launch command history, and shared command-history evidence resolve them through the namespace at runtime.
tests_added: Extended existing Local API WebView static assertions to require namespace-backed Launch backend-preflight access and reject the removed flat aliases.
Updated the command-evidence smoke fixture to seed Launch preflight evidence through mediaPipelineLaunchView.
manual_validation: Known unrelated validation note: ApplicationFacadeWebStaticTests.test_web_command_feedback_preserves_backend_warnings_and_errors currently fails on a pre-existing Rename text assertion unrelated to this Launch flat-export slice.
rollback_plan: Restore the eight Launch backend-preflight flat window assignments in launchView.js, switch Queue launch handoff, Launch command history, and shared command-history evidence back to flat alias lookup, revert the updated tests/docs/generated artifacts, refresh summaries, and rerun the targeted WebView validation ladder.
notes:
